text:
Jon (Sales): Passing Acera to CS. Closed last week, ARR $100k, 10 seats. Root contacts: Emily (CTO) <emily@acera.com>, Raj (Platform) <raj@acera.com>.

Priya (CS): Thanks — want to sync Wed. Where is the SOW?

Jon (Sales): SOW in DocuSign, awaiting legal sign. Expected Tue EOD. Billing contact: sara@acera.com.

Lina (Enablement): I'll run kickoff + 2x product trainings. Propose Apr 5 & Apr 12. Need list of use cases and power users.

Priya (CS): Onboarding goals: production-quality embeddings for semantic search, reranking for search scoring, SSO + SCIM, and data residency in us-east. Big ask: private VPC later. Risk: latency sensitivity at p99.

Sam (Support): Noted. If private VPC, support + eng need network plan (VPN/peering). Who owns the network touchpoints?

Jon (Sales): Raj will be the platform owner. They plan a pilot ~1k req/day, then ramp to ~30k/day after month 2.

Toby (Eng): Can we get their test payloads/logs? Also, any model preferences?

Jon (Sales): They prefer an open model path: Llama-2-70B quantized for now, possibility of private model hosting later. Target p99 latency ~200ms.

Priya (CS): Flagging renewal risk: contract auto-renews in 14 months; if latency or quality suffer during onboarding, renewal health drops. Success metrics to track: p99 latency <200ms, token cost per request target <$0.03, adoption 80% active seats monthly.

Priya (CS): Owners: Priya = onboarding lead, Lina = enablement, Sam = support/runbooks, Toby = eng escalation. I'll draft the onboarding playbook and share.

Lina (Enablement): Okta SSO + SCIM? I'll share our SSO checklist: `1) metadata exchange 2) test user 3) group sync` and a short training deck.

Sam (Support): I'll create runbook and error flows, tag `acera-onboard`, and set pager coverage 24/7 for first 72h after cutover.

Toby (Eng): I'll own perf tests. Plan: staging perf run (2h) once dataset is provided, instrument p99 traces and KV cache hit rates. If p99 >250ms in staging, escalate to infra pool.

Priya (CS): Next steps (short):
- Internal kickoff (Thu 10:00 PST) — invite sent.
- Jon to share dev account creds and DocuSign link.
- Acera to provide initial dataset/queries by Tue.
- Eng to run perf test by next Fri.
- Lina to schedule trainings (first week after kickoff).
- Create eval set for quality/regression checks.
- Trigger legal thread for data deletion policy.

deploy-bot: New meeting created: "Acera Onboarding" — Thu 10:00 PST. Invite sent to participants.

Jon (Sales): Sending dev account + contract link now: https://docusign.example/acera and dev creds via 1Password.

Priya (CS): I'll update the CS record and add to the renewal tracker and risk board. Also creating a Notion page for feedback capture and weekly notes.

Jon (Sales): One more ask from customer: white-glove data deletion policy & audit logs. Legal is negotiating specific language. Heads up.

Priya (CS): Added tag `legal:data-deletion` and will follow up with Legal.

Priya (CS): Assignment recap and due dates: Priya (onboarding owner) — ongoing; Lina (enablement) — training by Apr 12; Sam (support) — runbook & pager before cutover; Toby (eng) — perf test by next Fri; Jon (sales) — SOW sign expected Tue.

Priya (CS): Thanks everyone :raised_hands: — I'll post the playbook link once ready and start weekly syncs.

Jon (Sales): Thanks :party_parrot:
